products.notes: Marketed as 'VIGI 5MP Full-Colour Turret Network Camera' (5MP, not 4MP); max resolution 2880x1620. IP67, metal housing, 4x IR LED (850nm) + 4x white LED, 30 m each. TP-Link prints the model as 'InSight S455' with lens variants 'InSight S455 (2.8mm/4mm)' (V1 datasheet) and 'InSight S455 (2.8mm)' (V1.20 datasheet); the 'VIGI' prefix is not part of the printed model code. AU V1 page offers '2.8mm Lens' and '4mm Lens' packs; the AU V1.20 page offers only a '2.8mm Lens' pack. orderableVariants use 'VIGI InSight S455(<lens>)' for consistency with the rest of the catalogue. IT Plus SKUs S455-2.8 / S455-4 (titles 'TP-Link VIGI InSight S455 2.8MM' / 'S455 4MM') were read from IT Plus's public catalogue (no price); vigi.com/au was reachable, so no distributor fallback was used. 120 dB WDR (only DWDR when People & Vehicle Analytics is enabled). People & Vehicle Analytics (search/filter by attributes) must be used with VIGI specified software - recorded as smart_search. Abnormal Sound Detection is printed on both the AU page and both datasheets - recorded as audio_exception. Specs (incl. hfovByLensDeg 111.4/88 and 1/2.7" sensor) follow the AU product page and the V1 datasheet, which agree. The V1.20 datasheet differs - see conflicts. Successor/replacement: no statement found on the AU S455 page (V1/V1.20), either S455 datasheet or the AU VIGI C455 page that S455 replaces any C-series model. Nothing recorded. Vandal/IK rating is not printed anywhere. Conflicts: Image sensor: AU page (V1 and V1.20) and V1 datasheet print 1/2.7"; V1.20 datasheet prints 1/2.65". 2.8mm FOV: AU page and V1 datasheet print H 111.4 / V 58.8 / D 134 deg; V1.20 datasheet (2.8mm only) prints H 108.3 / V 59.9 / D 126.8 deg. The AU V1.20 page still shows the V1 values. Tilt adjustment: AU page prints 0-85 deg; both datasheets print 0-75 deg (not recorded in specs). Clients: AU page and V1 datasheet list VIGI Security Manager; V1.20 datasheet lists VIGI App, Web UI, VIGI VMS, VIGI Cloud VMS, VIGI Config Tool, VIGI PC Client (no Security Manager). 4mm lens: V1 datasheet and AU spec table list 2.8/4 mm; the V1.20 datasheet and AU V1.20 page only cover 2.8mm, so 4mm may be V1 hardware only. Datasheet: https://static.tp-link.com/upload/product-overview/2024/202410/20241018/InSight%20S455%201.0%20Datasheet.pdf
